newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pearl Oriental confirms probe into shares.
newsitem.headline: Pearl Oriental confirms probe into shares.

text.p: Luxury property developer and hotelier Pearl Oriental Holdings Ltd said Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) was conducting a probe into the trading of the company's shares.

"The company was informed by the SFC in writing in the afternoon today 13 June, 1997, that the SFC is conducting an investigation into the trading of the shares of the Company," Pearl Oriental said in a statement published in local newspapers on Saturday.
The company had said on Thursday that it knew of no probe into price movements of the company's shares by the territory's securities watchdog.

Pearl Oriental's shares tumbled HK$1.465, or 56.9 percent, over three days this past week to end at HK$1.110 on Thursday. On Friday it rebounded HK$0.25 to HK$1.36. Pearl Oriental's statement on Thursday had also addressed recent market rumours regarding the company's finances.
"The company is financially strong and has adequate financial resources ready for any possible acquisition projects," it said.
